name: Marching in Place

instructions.description: Stand tall near a support if needed and begin lifting one knee at a time in a steady rhythm.
Swing the opposite arm naturally to match each leg lift.
Keep your trunk upright and land softly through the whole foot.
Slow the march gradually before stopping.

performanceMetrics.notes: Useful for low-impact conditioning or warm-up.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Increase pace and knee height for a more vigorous option.

commentsNotes: Use a stable surface nearby if balance is limited.
Keep the steps quiet and controlled.
